summary: Monday (Nov 2) opens against a heavy Wall Street sell-off and oil near $117, cushioned by strong FII buying, a firmer rupee and a big Reliance profit beat.

detail.leaders: Reliance on a strong Q2 beat; autos after robust October sales
detail.laggards: IT after the Nasdaq's 2.9% slide; oil-sensitive names with Brent near $117
detail.tone: Friday ended a second straight up day with the Nifty at 23,053.10 (+0.51%) and about 2% higher for the week, but the rally was narrow and US tech has since slumped.
